items.prompt:
Use case: structural correction and style-transfer. One imaginative square card illustration for 穿刺.
Image 1 is the NovelAI draft and controls the tilted upper-right bronze bell, crimson organic vine direction and deep petrol-teal/gray-violet abstract background. Correct its vine exiting the open bell mouth: this must show a puncture THROUGH THE BELL'S SIDE WALL. Image 2 is approved 铸甲, STYLE ONLY for broad opaque matte curved-metal painting, hard grouped shadows, purposeful directional strokes and selective small contact contrast. Image 3 is approved 寻宝, STYLE ONLY for long sweeping brush shapes, quiet connected material masses and restrained detail. No borrowed hammers, armor, treasure chests or search rays.
The heavy bronze bell stays tilted upper-right with its crown out of frame, its broad flared mouth visible near lower-right. Keep the open mouth completely clear of the vine. Move the emergence point to a SMALL JAGGED HOLE in the SOLID FRONT WALL of the bell, above the rim, near image center. At that hole, two thick bent bronze lips curl outward, exposing pale raw metal edges and a dark inside. A SINGLE slender dark crimson thorny branch emerges through this tight hole and bends toward lower-left, then curls slightly upward at its tip. Branch thickness about one eighth the bell width, not the draft's thick pole. Exactly three readable large organic thorns, irregularly spaced; no many small spikes, flowers or leaves. Make the exit/puncture overlap unmistakable: nearest curled metal lip partially covers the branch root. This is the paradox of supple living thorns piercing heavy protective metal. The branch has broad curved tapered flow, no spearhead or weapon. Focus the sharpest local light-dark contrast at the damaged side-wall hole, subordinate all other highlights. No flying debris, blood or sparks.
Repaint all surfaces in the actual broad-brush style of Images 2–3. Loaded opaque flat-brush swipes curve around the bell; connected ochre, muted green-gray and deep blue-black paint masses explain thickness, with a few broad middle-tone turns and muted cream edge accents. Remove the smooth mirror highlight and grain coating from the draft. Metal is old matte bronze expressed with broad rough paint coverage, not fine patina texture, scratches or engravings. Crimson branch uses one long coherent curved swathe with a few broad rust-red turns; pointed thorn edges selectively crisp, large quiet crimson areas between them. Handmade broken stroke endings and sparse overlap marks, not uniform outlines or a field of tiny triangular facets. Keep secondary bell face quieter than the puncture. Background keeps deep petrol teal and muted gray-violet combination, coarsely brushed in broad subdued masses. No scenery, ropes, chains, extra props or characters. No text, frame, watermark or UI.
